about.title: About
paragraphs: I'm a Full Stack Developer and Tech Lead with solid experience managing the full software development lifecycle. My path ranges from facilitating agile teams as a Scrum Master to architecting corporate platforms and writing executive proposals for data governance and security.

I work with an end-to-end mindset, making sure infrastructure and back-end are robust while the front-end delivers a smooth, intuitive user experience. I care deeply about delivery quality, applying advanced practices such as code obfuscation, encryption and automated pipelines to protect system integrity.

What sets me apart is combining technical depth with strategic vision. I start from the business problem to build tailored platforms that not only solve today's needs but are ready to scale securely in any industry.

process.title: How it works
process.subtitle: A simple, transparent process — from the first conversation to continuous improvement.

conversa.title: Conversation
conversa.short: We get to know your business
conversa.happens: We talk on WhatsApp (or a call) to understand your business, your goals and what needs to be solved.
conversa.receive: A summary of the conversation and the recommended plan for your case, with a clear scope and a defined monthly fee.
conversa.do: Tell us about your business, your customers and what you expect from the project.

prototipo.title: Prototype
prototipo.short: See it before we build it
prototipo.happens: We design the layout and the main navigation flows so you can visualize the result before development starts.
prototipo.receive: A clickable prototype to review, comment on and approve.
prototipo.do: Review the prototype, send adjustments and approve the direction.

desenvolvimento.title: Development
desenvolvimento.happens: We build the solution following security best practices, with reviewed code and tests, keeping you in the loop at every stage.
desenvolvimento.receive: Frequent progress updates and access to a staging version to test.
desenvolvimento.do: Follow the deliveries, send copy, images and information, and validate the features.

publicacao.title: Launch & evolution
publicacao.happens: We launch the project, set up the domain and monitoring, and continue with ongoing maintenance.
publicacao.receive: Your website or system live, monitored and supported according to your plan.
publicacao.do: Use it, promote it and tell us what could be better — improvements flow into the maintenance cycle.

footnotes.1: Manpe subdomain in the format yourbusiness.manpestudio.com.br, included at no extra cost. To use your own domain, choose the Professional plan or higher.
footnotes.2: {domainClause} Manpe acts as the technical contact for the domain (at Registro.br, in Brazil) and handles yearly renewal and DNS setup.

plans.disclaimer: Extra features, complex integrations or third-party tools go through a scope review (Discovery) and may add to the monthly fee. Paid tools requested by the client can be purchased and managed directly by the client or managed by Manpe, with a corresponding increase in the monthly fee.

payment.a: Plans are monthly and prepaid: the fee is charged at the start of each cycle via Pix, boleto or card. There is no setup fee.

cancel.a: Cancelling only requires 30 days' notice, with no penalty. Your entire database and business information are exported and handed over to you — the data is yours, while the platform code is licensed. {domainClause}

domain.q: Is the domain registered in my name?
domain.a: Yes. The domain is registered under your name (CPF or CNPJ, in Brazil), with Manpe as the technical contact — we handle yearly renewal and DNS setup for you. {domainClause}

invoice.a: I currently work as an independent professional. Services are billed with a service receipt (individual) and formalized by a legally binding contract.

security.a: Security is a core pillar. We apply obfuscation, encryption and sound architecture practices so data is transmitted and stored in line with data protection guidelines.

scope.q: What if I need something outside my plan?
scope.a: Changes and extra features go through a scope review (Discovery). When needed, the adjustment is added to the monthly fee — always agreed with you beforehand.

maintenance.a: Yes. On-demand maintenance is included in every plan; what changes is the priority on changes and the response time, from within 48 h to within 12 h depending on the plan.

ownership.q: Who owns the code and the data?
ownership.a: The platform code is licensed for use while your plan is active. Your business data and your domain are yours — if you cancel, we export and hand over all your information.

plans.domainClause: The domain is owned by the client. If the subscription is canceled before 12 months, a transfer and registration fee of {fee} will be charged to cover the administrative and technical release of the domain to another host.
